item.title: The Caps have to do something now 📉
item.description: With their 5-3 loss to the Florida Panthers on Monday, the Washington Capitals’ record is 3-5-2 over the last ten games with just two regulation wins. Twenty days ago they were on a 107-point pace. Now it’s 95 points. The Washington Capitals are a playoff bubble team, and that might be putting it too kindly.
